description: This Java class represents an immutable JSON string wrapper, providing methods for creating, comparing, and serializing JSON string values, as well as handling their escaped representations.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonString
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON string value, efficiently handling string escaping and serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an ImmutableJsonString instance wrapping a specified string.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Indicates that this value is a string type.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the wrapped string value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the wrapped string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the JSON-escaped string representation, with lazy evaluation and caching.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the string value into the specified serialization context.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Estimates the upper bound size of the JSON string in characters, considering escape sequences.

methods.name: createStringRepresentation
methods.description: Creates the escaped JSON string version of the value, used internally for toString().
